notes: Gathered 2026-08-03 by read-only inspection of the live instance; no playback was started. THE CONTAINER NAME IS NOT STABLE: it is app-<nomad alloc id> and changes on every Music Assistant restart, including the restart that tools/ma_token.sh performs to mint a token. Re-derive it (see ENVIRONMENT.md) rather than trusting the value above. There is exactly ONE Alexa speaker group exposed by the Ampere provider ('Whole Apartment'), and all four of its members are allowed devices, so exercising the group does not drive an excluded speaker; no alternative group was needed. Beware a name collision: MA also has a DISABLED universal_group player 'ugp_sfvxyatc' that is likewise called 'Whole Apartment' - always select the group by player_id, never by display name. Home Theater is the only excluded device that is enabled and present in players/all, so it is the one an unfiltered test could accidentally hit. The MA library contains ONLY OpenSubsonic items plus builtin playlists - Deezer and SomaFM are enabled providers but are not synced into the library, so any Deezer or radio item must be addressed by its provider URI and will never show up in music/tracks/library_items, music/playlists/library_items or music/radios/library_items.
